alive.last_commit_message:
Filter the Butler board by Work stage (#1317)

The Butler board (All projects goal view) gains a Stage control beside
Group. The operator ticks one or more Work stage labels, or No stage, and
the board shows only goal chats in those stages. Each choice shows its
goal chat count.

Core: GET /butler/board accepts repeatable stage=<label> and
no_stage=true. Labels match case-insensitively across projects, and
subprojects use their nearest parent's stages (chat_work_stage). The
filter narrows items, section counts, project counts, Completed pages and
idle pages. The body adds stages (per-label section counts, in the
projects' stage order) and no_stage. These counts follow the search and
ignore the stage filter. The header's states stay unfiltered, so a filter
never hides a chat that waits on the operator. Active is filtered after
its turn states are counted.

UI: the device remembers the filter, like the grouping. A status line
names the filter, and Clear stage filter or Show all stages removes it. A
remembered stage that no chat has stays listed with 0. While a filter is
on, the bulk actions act only on the filtered set and say so: "Hold
active in Recon" holds the filtered running chats by name, and "Resume
idle in Recon" reads only that stage's idle goals and says other stages
are not resumed. A filter change drops the old board until Core answers.

Product help, the Butler mode destination guide and aliases cover the
filter. ui/playwright.config.ts restores butler-mode.spec.ts to the
assistant-real projects' testMatch (dropped in #1207), so area:butler-mode
collects again; its real-Core journey gains a stage-filter step.
